facts.fact: Business Tech Africa reports that the Bankers' Association of Botswana has launched a national eKYC project that lets banks verify customer identities against the national citizen database; the article gives no launch date.
The article says the Bankers' Association launched an eKYC system in 2021 that allowed commercial banks to verify identity cards against the national citizen database.
